question: Energy truce: deal or no deal?

lines.text: Ukraine's President Zelensky has offered Russia an energy truce.
lines.note: AFP via France 24, 11 Oct 2026: Zelensky on X

lines.text: He says Ukraine will stop striking Russian oil refineries if Russia stops hitting Ukraine's energy grid.
lines.note: Zelensky: 'Ukraine will be ready to stop striking Russian oil refineries if Russia stops striking our energy infrastructure.'

lines.text: His words: Any de-escalation steps must be reciprocal and backed by real guarantees.
lines.note: Zelensky on X, 11 Oct, via AFP

scene.quote: Any de-escalation steps must be reciprocal and backed by real guarantees.

lines.text: It comes after Donald Trump told Ukraine to stop hitting Russian refineries.
lines.note: Trump at the White House, 10 Oct: 'don't hit the refineries'

lines.text: Trump says the strikes push up diesel prices for American farmers and ranchers.
lines.note: Trump: 'he wants to make problems for our farmers, our ranchers, with diesel fuel'

lines.text: On Friday, Trump announced a deal letting Russia sell diesel worldwide, in return for sanctions relief.
lines.note: AFP: deal would see Russia release large amounts of diesel onto global markets in exchange for sanctions relief (announced 9 Oct)

lines.text: Zelensky called it a weak decision by our strong partners.
lines.note: Zelensky, 9 Oct: 'a weak decision by our strong partners'

scene.quote: a weak decision by our strong partners

lines.text: Ukraine's defence ministry says its strikes have disabled over half of Russia's refining capacity.
lines.note: Kyiv Independent: 'According to the Defense Ministry, Ukrainian attacks have disabled over 51% of Russia's total refining capacity.'

lines.text: Today, energy firm DTEK announced fresh power cuts in Kyiv.
lines.note: AFP: DTEK, Ukraine's largest private energy provider, announced fresh outages in Kyiv on Sunday

lines.text: In London, Defence Secretary Wes Streeting says the UK does not support the diesel deal.
lines.note: BBC: 'UK does not support Trump's Russia diesel deal, says Streeting'; PA via Express & Star: Defence Secretary, Sunday with Laura Kuenssberg

lines.text: He says Britain's role is to try and bring our friends back together.
lines.note: Streeting: 'Our approach, our role, our responsibility in this situation is to try and bring our friends back together.'

scene.quote: Our role, our responsibility in this situation is to try and bring our friends back together.

lines.text: The Kyiv Independent says Russia has so far shown no interest in a mutual pause.
lines.note: Kyiv Independent: 'Thus far, Russia has shown no interest in de-escalating attacks.'

lines.text: Energy truce: deal or no deal?

caption: Zelensky, Trump, Russian refineries: Ukraine's president says Kyiv will stop striking Russian oil refineries if Russia stops attacking Ukraine's energy grid. It follows Trump's criticism of the strikes and his diesel deal with Russia. Energy truce: deal or no deal?
notes_full: First reported 11 Oct 2026 about 09:40 UTC (Zelensky on X; Breakingthenews 09:41, Kyiv Post 09:56, Reuters, Times 10:25, AFP/France 24 10:21 and 11:03 UTC); about 2 to 3 hours old at delivery
